_doc: base_url normalization and leak discipline, before -> after (spec section 3.4, 3.8). Placeholders only: <credential> marks where real configs carry secret material; the agent never reads or emits it.

before_config_line._comment: as the harness config carries it (never emitted verbatim)

after_wire_facts._case: credential-shaped query param present -> host-only redaction
after_wire_facts.rule: scheme://authority (query/fragment stripped; the value of the key= parameter is never read, never echoed)

after_wire_facts._case: benign query and fragment -> stripped, base path kept

after_wire_facts.rule: userinfo ALWAYS stripped; the credential never read for reporting

after_wire_facts._case: credential-shaped string in an unexpected field -> whole row dropped before marshal
after_wire_facts.local_log: LOUD; reason carries the field and the rule, NEVER the value (mask-first: mask before truncate)
after_wire_facts.board_side: if it ever arrived, the ingest detector drops it and emits the models.credential_leak_suspected incident event (the agent itself emits no events)
